component.name: S3 Browser
component.summary: S3 uyumlu depolamayı gezin ve yönetin
Parcourir et gérer un stockage compatible S3
Explorar y administrar almacenamiento compatible con S3
Navegar e gerenciar armazenamento compatível com S3
تصفّح وإدارة التخزين المتوافق مع S3
浏览和管理 S3 兼容存储

description.p: S3 Browser is a desktop client for Amazon S3, Supabase Storage, MinIO, Cloudflare R2 and other S3-compatible services. The interface is available in nine languages.

ul.li: Browse buckets, upload, download, rename and delete objects, with transfer progress, cancellation and retry
Preview text and images, edit small text objects and HTTP headers in place
Sync a local folder to a bucket and run saved or scheduled backup jobs
List, restore and delete object versions
Analyze storage by folder, file type, age and storage class, and find duplicates
Copy or move objects between connections, including other providers
Search a bucket, open the command palette and keep favorite folders

screenshot.caption: Browsing a bucket with an image preview

description.p: Transfer queue with concurrency and bandwidth limits, bucket and object settings, Object Lock, ACL editing, parallel downloads, two-way folder sync, external editing, provider presets and mounting a bucket as a folder.
